description.zh: 供应链与物流场景专家——覆盖需求预测口径、库存策略、运输网络与转运路径优化、履约时效分析和物流成本拆解。分析以数据口径为先，事实与建议分离输出，适合电商/跨境/转运业务的运营与规划支持。
description.en: Supply chain and logistics expert — demand forecasting definitions, inventory policy, transport network and routing, fulfillment lead-time analysis and logistics cost breakdown. Data definitions first, facts separated from advice; built for e-commerce, cross-border and transshipment operations.

welcome_message.zh: 把你的业务场景或数据口径发我——库存、时效、路由还是成本？先对齐口径，再给分析与建议
welcome_message.en: Share your scenario or data definitions — inventory, lead time, routing or cost. We align on definitions first, then analysis and advice

description.zh: 按周转、缺货率与服务水平目标，诊断补货点/安全库存设置是否合理
description.en: Review reorder point and safety stock against turnover, stockout rate and service-level targets

prompt.zh: 请帮我诊断库存策略。业务背景：[填写业务与品类]；现状数据：[周转天数/缺货率/服务水平/补货周期等]；目标：[填写目标]。请先确认口径，再指出当前设置的问题并给出调整建议。
prompt.en: Please review our inventory policy. Context: [business and category]; current data: [turnover days / stockout rate / service level / replenishment lead time]; target: [your target]. Confirm definitions first, then flag issues and suggest adjustments.

description.zh: 把运费、仓储、操作、关税等成本拆到单票/单公斤，定位异常高的环节
description.en: Break freight, storage, handling and duty costs down per parcel / per kg and locate the outliers

prompt.zh: 请帮我拆解物流成本。成本构成：[填写各项成本]；业务量：[单量/重量段/目的地]；异常现象：[哪条线/哪个环节偏高]。请输出单位成本拆解表并指出优化空间最大的环节。
prompt.en: Please break down our logistics cost. Components: [cost items]; volume: [parcels / weight bands / destinations]; anomaly: [which lane or step looks expensive]. Output a unit-cost table and rank the biggest optimization opportunities.

description.zh: 对履约时效波动做环节归因：揽收、干线、清关、末端哪段变慢了
description.en: Attribute lead-time variance to pickup, line-haul, customs or last mile

prompt.zh: 请帮我定位时效异常。数据：[各环节时效分布或节点时间戳]；现象：[哪条线路/哪个时段变慢]；约束：[成本不可超/运力有限等]。请按环节归因，并给出可执行的改善动作。
prompt.en: Please diagnose our lead-time anomaly. Data: [segment-level lead times or node timestamps]; symptom: [which lane or period got slower]; constraints: [cost cap / capacity limit]. Attribute by segment and give actionable fixes.

zh: 每天「09:30」拉取前一日各线路时效数据，标记超出 SLA 的环节并输出异常日报
每周一「10:00」汇总上周物流成本与单量，输出单位成本周报与趋势
每月 1 日「09:00」生成上月库存周转与缺货率复盘，列出周转最差的 10 个 SKU
en: Every day at 09:30 pull yesterday's lane lead times, flag SLA breaches and send a daily exception report
Every Monday at 10:00 summarize last week's logistics cost and volume into a unit-cost report with trends
On the 1st of each month at 09:00 generate last month's inventory turnover and stockout review, listing the 10 worst SKUs
